text: Not confirmed yet. SX pregame odds are being read in every scan (the last four scans had no SX errors). The live-frame recorder is built and shipped. But the engine log has no sign of it recording live frames. That's likely because no SX game is live right now or because the recorder needs a socket key scope. I can't verify that from here, because the live journal only reaches GitHub when the run's archive step uploads it. Once a run shows live SX games, I'll read the journal and build the live feed. I'll look again at the next run.
